families.rationale: The card title names 'Investment Banking Analyst (single-turn IB tasks)'. Sell-side IB analyst work plausibly binds to ma_advisory ('Mergers, acquisitions and strategic advisory') at function_concept depth under R-CONCEPT. However, the card does not explicitly name M&A, and 'investment banking' conventionally also spans ECM/DCM/leveraged finance origination. From title/URL/class alone the binding is plausible but not unambiguous at the division level, and nothing supports task_concept or terminal_task depth. No pooling is applied: a single ma_advisory row is proposed and the other origination keys are left unbound.

Limits are stated in the mapping: sell-side facing only; single-turn analyst deliverables (not multi-turn deal execution, client coverage, or syndicate/bookrunning); function_concept depth only; no claim on ecm_origination, dcm_origination, capital_markets_origination_combined or leveraged_finance_loan_capital_markets. A later reader can falsify the map by showing the task families are not M&A/advisory-shaped analyst work.

The lexical false friend 'banking' is not used to promote treasury_balance_sheet_funding, institutional_sales_coverage, or any markets/trading, risk or operations key. Capital-markets origination keys (ECM/DCM/combined/levfin) are not promoted because the card does not cite syndicate, underwriting or book-building units of work; their terminality differs from generic IB analyst tasks.

The only basis for the proposed ma_advisory row is the card title and URL ('investment banking analyst tasks'). If the citation is removed, no residual basis remains and the mapping collapses; no owner intuition is used to fill it.

An outsider would likely reproduce the direction (IB analyst -> ma_advisory at function_concept via R-CONCEPT), but the choice between ma_advisory alone versus additional ECM/DCM rows and the band assignment are not uniquely determined by the title, catalogue labels and rubric, because the prompt does not define L1/L2/L3 semantics. Reproduction of the exact band is therefore uncertain.
